name: Benafigos (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a white castle flanked by two yellow crosses.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 11 July 2001 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4077 of 3 September 2001; it is a flag of 2:3, green, with a white castle at the centre flanked by two yellow crosses, the tower with the cross being the symbol of the old fortified church of Sant Joan.

features.role: a cross on each side of the castle
